description: Defines the NextcloudAPI interface for interacting with Nextcloud notes, including methods for CRUD operations and capabilities retrieval, along with extension functions for specific API calls.

methods.name: getNotesCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches the notes capabilities from Nextcloud server using the API.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from Nextcloud server.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note on Nextcloud server with given ETag.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on Nextcloud server.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID from Nextcloud server.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from Nextcloud server.
